'landing' == firing: v1 has no miss model). Stacks refresh the shared instance + expiry on each proc (standard engine stack semantics, guilty precedent). ATK ▲20.07% of the skill user's ATK continuously.': ENCODED as the SAME trigger re-declared on the skill2 slot (shotFired + fbGate:'inFb' + everyN:60) → allies casterAtkPct 20.07 / durationSec:6 — the co-extensive construction for a self-status gate (the selfStatus/requiresSelfStatus channel exists as of 2026-08-24; this shipped construction predates it, is behavior-equivalent, and is a mechanical re-encode candidate): the ATK buff applies on exactly the events that grant Cry stacks and carries the same 6s refresh window, so its uptime is IDENTICAL to Cry presence ([first proc, last proc + 6s] under both the engine's instance-refresh expiry and a per-stack-expiry reading — Cry presence = any-stack-alive in both). casterAtkPct resolves (20.07/100)×CLAY staticAtk as flat ATK per ally (sim.ts applyEffect) — exactly '20.07% of the skill user's ATK', NOT 20.07% of each holder's own ATK; 'continuously' = held across the status window, not a frame-0 permanent. BURST 'GO! GO! VICTORY!' — L1 'all allies: True Damage ▲12.56% for 10 sec' = burstCast → allies trueDamagePct 12.56 / durationSec:10 (her OWN cast only — she is the sole caster of her burst; NOT fullBurstEnter, which would over-fire on rotations a hypothetical competing B2 completed). L2 'self: normal attacks deal true damage for 10 sec' = burstCast → self weaponSwap {damagePct:10.12, trueNormals:true, durationSec:10} — the frima/takina same-weapon FLAVOR swap: damagePct = her own normal multiplier so swap shots deal EXACTLY her normal damage (baseMult = swap.damagePct ?? normalAttackMultiplier, sim.ts firePull) and only the FLAVOR changes; sameWeapon:true marks it as a gun that is never replaced, so there is no free reload at either end of the window (the kit grants none; sim.ts weaponSwap case). Both burst lines are cast-keyed and overlap by design (10s each from the same cast): the self true window is what converts the team True Damage ▲ stack into clay's OWN multiplier. trueDamagePct is FLAVOR-GATED (sim.ts dmgUp bucket): every True Damage ▲ line in this kit pays ONLY on true-flavored hits — clay's own swap-window normals + any teammate's true damage (ada's grenade DoT); inert on plain-damage allies. EVIDENCE TIER: all live values kit-text-literal (6.45×3/6s, 20.07, 12.56/10s, 10s true window); the estimated quantities are the cadence tuple (her own shots only) and the two ⚑s below. ⚑ MEASUREMENT-GATED (fable-S2b-adopted): the 60-hit counter's behaviour at the Full-Burst BOUNDARY — the kit text ('after landing 60 normal attacks during Full Burst') specifies WHICH hits count (in-FB only) but is silent on whether the accrued count resets when Full Burst ends. Encoded CARRYOVER (the everyN activation counter is cumulative across windows) — the literal reading restricts the counting, not the counter's lifetime. ESTIMATE: ≤1 marginal proc per fight (a full 10s FB window accrues ~3 procs on its own at the 20/s effective cadence, so cross-boundary remainder rarely changes a proc count).
